scope: Quatro linhas completas de concepts mumificados; 16 novas artes. Lore original proposta, sem integração.

families.name: Selacrábio
families.story: Aprende a enrolar uma faixa, proteger uma abertura e finalmente fechar câmaras contra ventos abrasivos. Não aprisiona almáticas: o selo se desfaz quando alguém oferece a linha sem puxar.
families.palette: turquesa profundo, ameixa, marfim de faixas, ouro fosco; olhos rosa-frio
forms: A very simple tiny living bandage roll with beetle-face integrated into the front fold, two short folded antenna tabs, two tiny foot-tabs, pink-cool gentle eyes. One plum paper flap hints at shell, one turquoise knot and one short braided rabiola ending a seal-shaped paper flag. Mostly ivory wrapping, 3-4 broad bands, no adult armor, no distinct torso. Its own rolled body is like a little protective seal, not a real beetle wearing clothes.

A small six-legged lively paper beetle, turquoise domed folded body with a plum divided shell, six short tab legs, two stubby antennae and gentle pink eyes. Broad ivory mummy wrapping crosses body in a simple X and binds wing-shell edges, visible knot hinges and bamboo edge. TWO little forelegs cradle a single broad curled bandage end as if learning to close a crack. One short rabiola anchored rear. No royal adult armor, no humanoid body. Ground beetle shape, juvenile curiosity.

Adolescent low hexapod beetle sealer, exactly SIX limbs: four supporting walking legs and two stout forward clamp-arms. Turquoise living-paper abdomen, split plum shell formed as two hinged seal jaws behind shoulders, broad ivory wrappings tensioned across plates, bamboo curved ribs and matte brass rims. Small pink-eyed insect head with short forked horn, not human. Clamp arms have flat seal-pad palms, learning to bring two pad surfaces together, no hand weapon. One complete rabiola. Agile low broad silhouette, not adult upright heavy body.

ADULT imposing heavy BIPED scarab guardian: exactly TWO powerful legs and TWO massive seal-press arms, compact abdomen/waist, broad plum and turquoise armored torso built of tensioned paper, two large closed elytra overlap behind shoulders like hinged sealing doors, not flight wings. Small mature insect helmet-head with short bifurcated beetle brow and narrow cool-pink eyes, a closed ivory jaw visor. Broad ivory MUMMY WRAPPINGS around shoulder roots, torso and greaves, arranged as functional tension braces; some bandage edges become long rear folded paper tabs. Matte pale-gold rims, bamboo lateral frame and turquoise knot hinges. Forearms end in broad asymmetrical flat stamp-shields (one split-circle raised relief, other matching depression), used to clamp and seal, not swords. One intact braided soul-rabiola at lower back with round seal terminal. Adult authority, thick but proportional frame, no gem, no human exposed face, no ornate microtextures.

families.name: Ibiscrito
families.story: As faixas recebem marcas de vento, não almas. O que começa como um risco vira um mapa de sons; o adulto registra avisos e devolve mensagens sem alterar o que ouviu.
families.palette: carmesim, azul-noite, marfim, latão fosco; olhos verde-menta
forms: Earliest tiny living kite bird: one ivory triangular folded head-body, small curved navy paper beak, two soft crimson cheek-wing tabs, two tiny foot tabs. Gentle mint eyes. Three broad mummy bands around lower fold with a single small original graphic dash, no readable writing. One short braided rabiola ending a tiny crimson folded nib. Very simple few shapes, no long neck or adult costume.

Small curious juvenile ibis-like paper bird, two short stilt legs and TWO short folded wings, small curved navy beak, mint eyes, short ivory folded neck. Crimson/navy paper body, broad mummy strips crossing breast and wing leading edges, a little brass bamboo quill-edge along each wing. One rabiola ending a folded nib, distinct from wing bandages. Learning to trace an arc with one wing tip, not holding human pen. Light posture, big readable shapes, no adult robe or staff.

Lean adolescent ibis courier with two long bird legs, two long narrow folded paper wings, extended curved navy beak and smaller focused mint eyes. Neck is an S of broad ivory mummy bands, crimson/navy torso with sparse brass shoulder guards. Wing feathers are SIX large layered paper-strip vanes per wing rather than natural fine feathers; dark graphic dash motifs on selected bands only. A taut bamboo leading rib per wing and knot roots. One wing forward tracing a wind arc, other rear, clearly two wings. One long soul-rabiola like rolled scroll terminal. No fully adult long ceremonial mantle or crown.

ADULT tall majestic ibis SCRIBE creature, avian not human: TWO stilt bird legs and TWO large folded wings acting as calligraphy fans. Mature narrow mint eyes, long strongly curved navy beak, small split ink-nib crest. Ivory bandaged long neck and wrapped torso, crimson/navy folded-paper mantle surfaces integrated with TWO wings; each wing constructed from a hierarchy of broad mummy strips with dark abstract wind-notation, bamboo leading ribs and matte brass corner reinforcements. In a controlled three-quarter wings-half-spread gesture, one elongated wingtip is a curved quill blade used to write air, no held staff/sword. Four broad ribbons float as wing edge extensions but all ROOTS connected, not extra tails. Single distinct braided rabiola rooted at lower back with a rolled-scroll folded terminal. Restrained ceremonial armor at shoulders and shins, no gem, no human arms/hands or humanoid face. Strong authoritative silhouette and clear bird anatomy.

families.name: Crocáfago
families.story: Começa protegendo uma poça com o próprio corpo; aprende a abrir o dorso em abrigo e se torna uma passagem móvel sobre correntes perigosas. Só transporta quem sobe por vontade própria.
families.palette: jade, ardósia, argila vermelha, marfim; olhos lavanda
forms: A tiny simple wrapped paper pod shaped like a rounded crocodile snout-face, gentle lavender eyes, two tiny forefoot tabs and a short folded rear point. Ivory broad mummy bands, jade forehead and clay-red underside crease. One small slate folded lid flap on back. One attached short string rabiola with stepped paper terminal. Three/four big folds only, no developed limbs, teeth, realistic scales or equipment. Friendly earliest living kite guardian.

Small playful QUADRUPED living paper crocodile, exactly four short rooted legs with broad little feet, short rounded jade fold-muzzle and lavender eyes, smooth belly. Broad ivory mummy wraps circle trunk and legs; three slate folded dorsal lid panels and a red-clay bamboo edging. Tail-body short broad wedge plus one distinct string rabiola from upper tail root. It crouches to cover an imaginary small gap, no props. No big adult tooth rows or chest armor, naturalistic scales absent.

Adolescent mobile crocodile living paper shelter, FOUR longish rooted legs and narrow athletic jade torso, elongated mature-but-not-adult folded muzzle with lavender eyes, small sparse teeth. Three slate/red-clay dorsal plates hinge outward as incomplete protective lid, broad ivory mummy bands tension these plates to a bamboo curved side frame. Body is broad smooth paper, not skin. Upper forelegs have small clay guards, feet broad. Mid-turn stepping to shield a passage. Tail-body shorter than torso and a separate single rabiola, no extra tail. No adult massive enclosed back-vault.

ADULT massive low QUADRUPED crocodilian gatekeeper, exactly FOUR grounded limbs with powerful broad three-clawed feet; broad short heavy jade folded snout, mature lavender eyes recessed under layered brow, moderate cream triangular teeth not excessive. Huge back forms a protective hollow-looking SLATE and RED-CLAY folded PAPER VAULT with THREE hinged rectangular lid-ribs and bamboo arched side supports, edges stepped like a temple gate. Broad ivory MUMMY WRAPPINGS bind neck, limb roots and dorsal lid hinges, a few loose connected tabs; bare areas remain broad smooth jade paper volumes. Distinct functional armor substantial but not a turtle dome, tail-body broad and compact forming last gate threshold, ONE separate braided rabiola from upper tail root with stepped terminal. Mature commanding low stance angled toward viewer, one back lid slightly ajar showing ivory folded interior, no person or extra creature inside. No gem, no realistic reptile scales, no gore or skeleton.

families.name: Velaravan
families.story: De pequeno casulo que acompanha passos a condutor de rotas. A corcova guarda faixas que vibram como mapas sonoros. O adulto reduz o ruído da tempestade para o grupo ouvir o próximo marco.
families.palette: índigo, terracota, marfim, cobre; olhos azul-gelo
forms: Tiny simple living paper journey-bundle with integrated gentle ice-blue eyes, ivory wrapped head-body, two long folded ear tabs and two tiny support foot-tabs, a little terracotta snout crease hints camel. ONE indigo folded hump-flap on upper back, one copper knot and one short rabiola ending a small pennant. Broad 3-4 mummy bands, no adult saddle/shrine/equipment. Almost a folded travel amulet, a living kite organism, not plush real camel.

Curious small FOUR-legged dromedary-like living paper companion, four short long-toed padded feet, gently curved modest neck, camel muzzle with two little folded lips, long ivory ears, ice-blue eyes. One small indigo/terracotta folded hump, broad ivory mummy wrapping around neck and trunk, smooth broad paper body, bamboo edge along small hump. One short rabiola with terracotta pennant. No human saddle, no rider, no adult heavy canopy. Walking and listening head tilt.

Adolescent lean FOUR-legged living paper dromedary pathfinder, long legs with visible rooted joints and paired broad padded toes, long S-neck built of broad ivory mummy wraps, angular camel head with ice-blue eyes and two long fold ears. Single narrow hump supporting TWO partly unfolded indigo/terracotta kite vanes as acoustic wind-screens, copper rim guards only at knees/shoulders, bamboo spar across hump. One small hollow ceramic resonator at center of shoulder collar, not a gem. ONE soul-rabiola, no loose duplicate tails. Purposeful forward stride, not heavily laden adult shrine.

ADULT imposing tall FOUR-legged living paper dromedary caravan guardian, one powerful hump, long wrapped S-neck and small mature angular camel muzzle, ice-blue eyes, two long split fold ears. Indigo and terracotta paper body made from broad tensioned membranes under thick ivory MUMMY WRAPPINGS, not flesh. The SINGLE hump grows into a grand folded wind-canopy of TWO broad indigo terracotta paper vanes on copper/bamboo arches, part of body not a saddle; three large hollow matte ceramic resonator chambers hang SECURELY under the canopy at distinct roots, like listening bells with open slots, no fire/smoke. Substantial copper/indigo knee and shoulder armor, broad two-toed padded feet, four readable roots, tall broad frame, not skeletal. Neck wraps carry sparse abstract route-dash motifs, no readable real script. One complete braided soul-rabiola with terracotta sail terminal at rear. Solemn protective stance with head lowered to listen, no rider or other character, no crystal or camel fur realism.
